title: Necessary Paperwork to Establish State National and State Citizen Status By Anna Von Reitz
summary: Anna Von Reitz lists the expatriation, name-repatriation and assumed-name records she says restore American State National status.

assertions.quote: declare by act of expatriation that you are not any kind of federal territorial or municipal United States citizen
deliberately misidentified you as a federal citizen and got your mother to sign undisclosed and deceitful paperwork

verdicts.note: Birth registration records a birth; citizenship arises from the Fourteenth Amendment and statute, not from paperwork signed by the mother.
Under the Fourteenth Amendment persons born in the US and subject to its jurisdiction are citizens at birth by operation of law, not by hospital paperwork.
Under the 14th Amendment all persons born in the US are citizens of the US and their state; claims to be only a 'free born citizen' of a state are uniformly rejected.

assertions.quote: need to be established on the International land record via land recording office any land recording office will do

verdicts.note: Recorders accept documents without validating them; citizenship status changes only through federal renunciation procedures.

assertions.quote: they may go out on the sea of international trade or that Sea of Commerce again but they have to be recognized as vessels
you simply gain back your rights and freedoms for which you have struggled and sacrificed and regain control of your private property assets

verdicts.note: The paperwork has no legal effect on rights or property; courts ignore it.
